C:P1.2.text: DHI Group, Inc. is a family of purpose-built talent platforms - each built for a specific professional community, not a one-size-fits-all marketplace. DHI Group powers ClearanceJobs and Dice, the platforms top tech talent turn to and employers rely on. Our AI-powered tools and proprietary skills algorithm do the heavy lifting, matching the right candidate to the right opening, fast.

C:P1.3.text: Dice is the largest technology-focused talent marketplace in the United States, built over more than 35 years with nearly 8 million technology profiles. Unlike generalized professional networking platforms, Dice organizes talent around more than 100,000 distinct technology skills, allowing recruiters to identify candidates based on the precise capabilities they need.

C:P1.4.text: ClearanceJobs is the leading marketplace for professionals with active U.S. security clearances, serving multiple customers, including Lockheed Martin, Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, Raytheon, and many others. ClearanceJobs has 2 million cleared candidate profiles, reinforcing our position as the industry's premier destination for cleared technology talent.

C:P2.1.text: DHI Group, Inc. - About - Company Profile

C:P2.2.text: At DHI Group, Inc., we operate a family of purpose-built talent platforms, each built for a distinct professional community, not a one-size-fits-all marketplace.

C:P2.3.text: Each platform keeps the focus and identity that earned it category leadership. What we provide underneath is shared scale, capital discipline, an M&A engine, and centralized corporate functions, so each platform can invest fully in the customers it knows best.

C:P2.4.text: We believe DHI is uniquely positioned at the intersection of two powerful, durable trends: rising global defense spending and growing demand for highly specialized technology talent, particularly in AI.

C:P2.5.text: We are successfully extending our platforms into adjacent services, creating new monetization opportunities and deepening our relationships with customers.
